cohort: The study participants were Strong Start enrollees and Medicaid-covered women who received typical prenatal care.
finding: Women receiving prenatal care in birth centers experienced lower rates of preterm and low-birthweight infants, lower cesarean section rates, and higher VBAC rates at lower costs compared to those receiving typical care, while other Strong Start models showed limited or no improvements in outcomes.
mod_finding: Women who received prenatal care in birth centers had lower rates of cesarean section and higher rates of vaginal birth after cesarean.
